prompt:
Create a fintech marketplace directory page for business funding products. The page should allow users to browse funding options like revenue-based financing, equipment financing, invoice factoring, business lines of credit, SBA loans, startup funding, ecommerce financing, and gig worker funding.
Visual style: modern marketplace with filterable product cards, clean SaaS layout, dark header, white card grid, colored category tags, and strong CTAs.
Strong hook: “Find the Right Funding Lane Before You Waste an Application.”
Hero message: “Compare business funding options by speed, requirements, use case, and best-fit borrower profile.”
CTA: “Compare Funding Options”
Sections needed:
- Hero section
- Search and filter bar
- Funding product cards
- Best for tags
- Speed indicators
- Requirement badges
- CTA on each card
- Explanation section
- FAQ
- Final CTA
Generate static files with JavaScript filtering.
